subject: Pilot blueprint and access timeline — CartoLabs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cartolabs.com>

Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@cartolabs.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot kickoff — next steps and what we need from Redwood

Hi Priyom and Ben,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment before we lock the kickoff date: 

- Primary pain: our annotators spend too long curating suggestions for location normalization and business categorization; we need higher precision at low latency.
- Goal: reduce human-in-the-loop time by 50% for the initial suggestions, keep median inference latency < 120ms for single-record requests, and maintain > 92% correctness on the 2k validation prompt set.
- Scope for pilot: 4-week evaluation focusing on the address-normalization flow and the multi-field categorization prompt set (approx. 2k prompts).

What we need from Redwood to get started:
1) Pilot charter and success metrics (one-pager) to share with our product leads.
2) A short prompt-set eval plan and preliminary prompt templates we can iterate on.
3) Access checklist: service account credentials, S3 buckets/ingest path, and IP allowlist steps for our staging VPC.

We can commit engineering time the week of May 18th for integration. Are you able to start environment prep the week of May 11th? Also confirming the NDA is signed (attached).

Best,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Platform, CartoLabs
liam@cartolabs.com

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — next steps and what we need from Redwood

Hi Liam (and Sana),

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our notes. Confirming next steps and owners so we can convert this into a pilot charter and an access timeline. I’ll attach the draft charter and checklist now.

Summary of what Redwood will deliver for the 4-week pilot (deliverable view):
- Pilot charter (attached): scope, success metrics, evaluation plan, and rollback criteria. Owner: Priyom (I will be your primary contact).
- Prompt/eval plan: we will provide an initial prompt suite (2,000 prompts split: 70% normalization, 30% categorization) + templates for targeted A/B prompt tests. Owner: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai).
- Runtime/access provisioning: temporary service account + S3 read-only ingest path, plus an IP allowlist entry for CartoLabs staging. Owner: Grace O'Connor (grace@redwood.ai).

Timeline (proposed):
- Week of May 11: Environment prep (service account, buckets, allowlist).
- Week of May 18: Integration and initial prompt-run (first 200 prompts).
- Week of May 25: Iteration on prompts + metric tuning.
- Week of June 1: Full 2k prompt evaluation and results review.

Success metrics (pilot-ready):
- Human-in-loop time: target 50% reduction (baseline = current avg 14s per suggestion)
- Latency: median < 120ms at single-record (p99 < 400ms under sample load)
- Quality: > 92% correctness on labeled 2k validation set

Access checklist (high level):
1) CartoLabs creates a staging S3 bucket or provides presigned URLs for the prompt set.
2) Provide a contact for networking (IP and CIDR for allowlist).
3) Share a test row sample and schema for the normalization flow.

Attachments included: CartoLabs-pilot-charter-v1.pdf, network-access-checklist.xlsx. I see the signed NDA you attached — thanks.

Can you confirm the staging VPC contact and whether you prefer we use a pre-provisioned service account or create one on your behalf? Once I have that we’ll schedule the environment prep for May 11.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
